definitionZh: 红宝石位置 CSS 属性定义了红宝石元素相对于其基元素的位置. 它可以在元素(over)之上,在元素(over)之下(under),或者在右边(inter-charter)放置.
sourceDefinition: The ruby-position CSS property defines the position of a ruby element relative to its base element. It can be positioned over the element (over), under it (under), or to the right (inter-character).
